protocol.role: Full benchmark supplementary development evaluation; five seeds, equal requested MIP calls
protocol.variant_policy: legacy versus num_machines-only correction; retain legacy horizon to isolate feature dimensionality
protocol.calibration_policy: original argsort heuristic, evenly spaced rank positions including both endpoints; all feasible incumbents accepted
protocol.fallback_policy: original mean feasible calibration labels; infinity if none
protocol.tie_policy: original numpy.argsort default; environment version recorded
protocol.baseline_policy: HeurSeq Top-35 from identical independent test pool, no calibration labels
protocol.cache_policy: shared evaluation bank for identical instance/assignment/parameters; charge each method its own unique requests and all calibration calls; report physical cache hits separately
protocol.outcome_policy: report calibration best, final Top-5 best, combined MIP best and heuristic-only best separately; no end-to-end wall-clock matching claim
protocol.model_check: compare Gurobi model fingerprints for legacy/corrected versions for every unique solved assignment
protocol.validation: independent operation coverage, assignment, duration, precedence, nonoverlap and objective checks for each feasible MIP schedule
protocol.expansion_gate: protocol parity, complete records and schedule validity; do not gate expansion on method winning
limitations: five development seeds on one benchmark family
5-second incumbents vary with hardware and timing
automatic Gurobi thread count depends on machine
shared bank is a paired replay, not independently timed method execution
legacy horizon retained; only MK06 machine count corrected
MK06 seeds42/43 reused from archived pilot with matching code, environment and per-case settings

analysis_plan.primary: Corrected AL-RF best over calibration+Top-5 versus HeurSeq Top-35, averaged within each instance across five seeds
analysis_plan.secondary: Corrected AL-RF final Top-5 versus HeurSeq Top-5; label calibration overhead explicitly
analysis_plan.statistics: Two-sided signed-rank test on instance means, average tied ranks, exact sign enumeration, numerical tie tolerance 0.001; primary and secondary reported separately
analysis_plan.missing: Keep no-incumbent outcomes and feasibility counts; no imputation; paired means/tests only on instances with all five paired finite outcomes, listing exclusions
analysis_plan.reporting: All ten instances and all five predetermined seeds, per-seed raw rows, means, sample SDs, win/tie/loss, solver cost and unique calls; full-five and added-three results separately
analysis_plan.claims: Seeds 42-46 overlap historical development work; no independent confirmation or holdout claim. No equal end-to-end wall-clock claim.
